properties.label: Pan (deg)
properties.description: The horizontal pan angle in degrees for the moving head fixture. Controls left/right beam positioning.

properties.label: Tilt (deg)
properties.description: The vertical tilt angle in degrees for the moving head fixture. Controls up/down beam positioning.

properties.label: Fan Pan
properties.description: Pan offset in degrees applied incrementally across grouped fixtures, fanning them apart horizontally. Creates a spread effect when multiple heads are grouped.

properties.label: Fan Tilt
properties.description: Tilt offset in degrees applied incrementally across grouped fixtures, fanning them apart vertically. Creates a spread effect when multiple heads are grouped.

properties.label: Groupings
properties.description: Number of fixture groupings for fan offset distribution. Fixtures within the same group share the same pan/tilt, with fan offsets applied between groups.

properties.label: Cycles
properties.description: Number of full movement cycles to complete over the effect duration. Controls how many times a pathing animation repeats.

properties.label: MHPathDef
properties.description: Encoded definition string for the movement path. Defines waypoints and curves that the moving head beam follows over time.

iPad-only fixture selection: eight toggles for Moving Head slots 1-8. Each toggle flips the matching MH*_Settings entry between active and empty. Position slider changes (Pan / Tilt / Offsets / Groupings / Cycles) automatically re-sync into every active fixture, as do the Pattern, shutter and Link settings. Colour, dimmer intensity, waypoint path drawing and parametric patterns each have their own tab.
iPad-only explanatory banner for the Moving Head inspector.
iPad single-colour authoring: SwiftUI ColorPicker writes a single HSV triple into the active fixtures' Color: command.
iPad colour-wheel picker for colour-wheel fixtures: a strip of the model's wheel slots that writes a single-colour Wheel: command. Hidden for RGB/CMYW fixtures.
iPad dimmer intensity authoring: a flat-ramp 0..100% slider that writes a constant Dimmer: command into the active fixtures.
iPad waypoint path editor: a touch Canvas that draws Bezier (line / quadratic / cubic) waypoint paths plus path presets, writing the same Path: command desktop's Effect Assist reads.

properties.label: Scale
properties.description: Scales the size of the movement path. Positive values enlarge the path, negative values shrink it, and zero uses the default size.

properties.label: Time Offset
properties.description: Shifts the starting point in time along the movement path. Use to stagger multiple fixtures following the same path at different phases.

properties.label: Ignore Pan
properties.description: When enabled, the pan component of the path is ignored, keeping the fixture at its current horizontal position while only tilt changes.

properties.label: Ignore Tilt
properties.description: When enabled, the tilt component of the path is ignored, keeping the fixture at its current vertical position while only pan changes.

properties.label: Auto Shutter
properties.description: When enabled, the fixture shutter automatically opens when the dimmer is above zero and closes when the dimmer is zero, preventing unwanted light leaks during repositioning.

properties.label: Enable Shutter
properties.description: Holds the fixture shutter open at the model's Shutter On value for the whole effect. Auto Shutter still takes over when it is active.

properties.label: Enable Pattern
properties.description: Drives Pan/Tilt from a parametric shape generator instead of (or on top of) the waypoint path.

properties.label: Shape
properties.description: Parametric shape the beam traces over the effect duration. Modelled on QLC+ EFX shapes.

properties.label: Width
properties.description: Half-width of the pattern in pan degrees.

properties.label: Height
properties.description: Half-height of the pattern in tilt degrees.

properties.label: X Offset
properties.description: Pan-axis centre of the pattern in degrees.

properties.label: Y Offset
properties.description: Tilt-axis centre of the pattern in degrees.

properties.label: Rotation
properties.description: Rotates the whole pattern about its centre, in degrees. Animate it with a value curve to spin the shape over the effect.

properties.label: Start Offset
properties.description: Shifts where along the shape the beam starts, in degrees.

properties.label: Head Spread
properties.description: Staggers grouped fixtures along the shape so they chase each other around it. Only meaningful for a model group.

properties.label: X Frequency
properties.description: Lissajous only: pan-axis frequency multiplier.

properties.label: Y Frequency
properties.description: Lissajous only: tilt-axis frequency multiplier.

properties.label: X Phase
properties.description: Lissajous only: pan-axis phase in degrees.

properties.label: Y Phase
properties.description: Lissajous only: tilt-axis phase in degrees.

properties.label: Link end position to next Moving Head effect
properties.description: Snaps every active head's Pan/Tilt to where the next Moving Head effect on this row starts, and forces the Dimmer to 0 so the head moves into position dark.
iPad Link tab body: per-head sync preview plus a Re-sync button, mirroring desktop's StaticText_MHLinkPreview.
